used_additions.sentence: For a child with diabetes symptoms, contact the GP practice urgently or use NHS 111 if unsure; call 999 if a child is very drowsy, confused, breathing fast or deeply, has severe tummy pain or keeps vomiting.
used_additions.evidence: 111 Wales: urgent GP contact or NHS 111; 999 for those emergency signs.

used_additions.sentence: In someone with diabetes, loss of appetite, feeling or being sick, a high temperature, stomach pain or fruity-smelling breath needs urgent medical attention, so call NHS 111 or 999 if severe.
used_additions.evidence: NHS 111 Wales advises these signs need urgent medical attention.

used_additions.sentence: Remission means blood sugar stays below the diabetes level for at least six months without diabetes medicine.
used_additions.evidence: HbA1c underneath the diagnostic level for a minimum of six months without glucose-lowering medication.
